about: planetscale's decision table (the P3 procedure), for the vendor and its api lane. psdb (the root unit) serves one operation, Execute, which runs a statement against the branch the password names in the session the client carries; the SQL is the pack's engine (src/engine/sql.ts, pure) over the tree's tables and rows (src/semantics/shared.ts). The api lane (planetscale/api) serves one operation, create_backup, Dub's trigger-backup cron; a database, its passwords and the organization's service tokens are the dashboard's (the lane's screens). Every other operation of either spec is the gap, the declared resources' named in each manifest's unmodeled; no refresh scope names an operation (each resource's refresh is none, with why).

decisions.demand: Dub's @planetscale/database connection, its edge Prisma client and its Prisma client given the adapter by the injector; Substrate's Prisma client in a tab over @prisma/adapter-planetscale
decisions.why: a statement run, not a stored resource: its writes are subject writes (a table one subject, a row one), held in the session until COMMIT inside a transaction; the answer is psdb's envelope, each row's lengths and base64 values; a password's role refuses what it may not run

decisions.demand: Dub's trigger-backup cron (POST …/branches/main/backups with a service token)
decisions.why: a stored mutation the core cannot state: the token is read from PlanetScale's scheme-less Authorization header and must hold write_backups on the database; the backup is written pending and the clock moves it to running and success

decisions.demand: the World's refresh of a vendor-backed root: each backup Dub's cron made, read back by its id (list_backups stays the gap), and the API reference's published example
decisions.why: A backup of the branch the token may read (read_backups), answered as create_backup stored it; the read the World's known refresh makes, by the names the backup was made under.

decisions.demand: twin-world's runtime issuing an application's PLANETSCALE_DATABASE_URL at boot (the descriptor's credentialDoor)
decisions.why: a branch password is made on the dashboard's Connect page, not through any API the application calls; the World issues the application's

decisions.demand: the dashboard sign-in every screen asks for, where Dub's service token and passwords are made
decisions.why: a person and their organization come from PlanetScale's sign-up, which no API reaches; the World stands in for it
